correctness.rationale: The Rayleigh quotient of a unit section direction ranges over the eigenvalue interval for its block projection. Preservation of full diameter is equivalent to straddling c=1/(1+h²). Bivector minors yield the quadratic ellipse condition; independent uniform self-dual and anti-self-dual coordinates turn it into ellipse area under constant density 1/2 in a diamond. Cauchy–Schwarz proves containment for all h>0. The resulting probability πh/[2(1+h²)] is exact. AM–GM proves the unique maximizer; direct constructions prove the dimensional thresholds. The standalone numerical checks passed but are not substituted for the proof.
